an8.64:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Gayāyaṃ viharati Gāyāsīse.
an8.64:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:-- Bhikkhavo ti. Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an8.64:1.3: Pubbāhaṃ bhikkhave sambodhā anabhisambuddho bodhisatto 'va samāno obhāsaṃ hi kho sañjānāmi, no ca rūpāni passāmi.
an8.64:2.2: ‘sace kho ahaṃ obhāsañ c' eva sañjāneyyaṃ rūpāni ca passeyyaṃ,
an8.64:2.3: evam me idaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ parisuddhataraṃ assā' ti.
an8.64:3.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave aparena samayena appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañ c' eva sañjānāmi rūpāni ca passāmi,
an8.64:3.2: no ca kho tāhi devatāhi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhāmi sallapāmi sākacchaṃ samāpajjāmi. 3.
an8.64:4.2: ‘sace kho ahaṃ obhāsañ c' eva sañjāneyyaṃ rūpāni ca passeyyaṃ tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṃ santiṭṭheyyaṃ sallapeyyaṃ sākacchaṃ samāpajjeyyaṃ,
an8.64:4.3: evam me idaṃ ñāṇadassanaṃ parisuddhataraṃ assā' ti.

an8.64:9.1: So kho ahaṃ bhikkhave aparena samayena appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto obhāsañ c' eva sañjānāmi rūpāni ca passāmi tāhi ca devatāhi saddhiṃ santiṭṭhāmi sallapāmi sākacchaṃ samāpajjāmi tā ca devatā jānāmi

an8.64:10.1: Yāva kīvañ ca me bhikkhave evaṃ aṭṭhaparivaṭṭhaṃ adhidevañāṇadassanaṃ na suvisuddhaṃ ahosi, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an8.64:10.2: Yato ca kho me bhikkhave evaṃ aṭṭhaparivaṭṭaṃ adhidevañāṇadassanaṃ suvisuddhaṃ ahosi, athāhaṃ bhikkhave sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddho paccaññāsiṃ.
an8.64:10.3: Ñāṇañ ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi
an8.64:10.4: ‘akuppā me cetovimutti, ayam antimā jāti, natthi dāni punabbhavo' ti. 1.
